lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three vertical columns of high-luminance circular blobs are visible on the posterior peduncle region. The leftmost visible column contains two vertically stacked spots; the central column contains two vertically stacked spots; the rightmost column near the caudal base contains three spots in a triangular cluster.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity align with the vertical spot columns, forming anchor nodes where the high-luminance blobs are centered.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature runs along the lateral midline of the caudal peduncle, showing a high-contrast gradient with a light upper edge and a shadowed lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The upper lobe of the caudal fin exhibits at least four discrete, low-diameter high-luminance blobs scattered across its visible surface.
